purpose: Unfilled teacher-only prerequisites for actual fictional conduct role ndv-337-020.
steps: Teacher checks class suitability, instructions, acceptable communication/access route and original rubric before use.
Use a safe existing classroom prop and an explicitly fictional noticed crack; do not damage an object or create a real debt or payment.
A teacher or partner takes the lender role. Observe the learner disclosing what was noticed, avoiding invented blame/confession, asking about a suitable next step and responding respectfully.
A written plan is insufficient for the demonstration criterion. Retained evidence follows school policy; this file contains no learner identity or recording.
No actual prayer, fasting, pilgrimage, recitation or moral judgment of a child’s faith is part of this narrow role.
